author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a swinging steady beat, high and low, loud and soft, stop and go, and playing together, with an old circle game.

classes.title: Skip around the farm
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and bounce to its skipping beat together.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling a long-short skip that comes back again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Bounce your child gently on your knee on every big beat.
classes.childAction: Bounce, clap and pat your knees with the song.
classes.bridge: The beat skips like a farmer walking round the circle: hop-a, hop-a.

intro.caption: Listen and sway
intro.parentCue: Bounce your child gently on your knee

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and bouncing to the beat.

classes.title: Farmer's big steps
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on every big beat while the grown-up plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each big beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once on each big beat.
classes.bridge: Each big beat is one farmer boot stepping round the circle.

intro.caption: Tap on every beat
intro.parentCue: Tap your child's knee on each big beat first

games.caption: Farmer steps, nice and slow
games.parentCue: Tap together on the long notes

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each big beat.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds and tap the matching side of the piano.

mathTarget.parentLine: Low sounds live on the left, high sounds on the right

classes.parentPrompt: Growl and crouch for the bear; flap your arms and stretch up for the bird.
classes.childAction: Bear: tap the left side. Bird: tap the right side.
classes.bridge: Bear lives low on the left, bird high on the right; the tune climbs a step.

intro.caption: Here comes the bear, here comes the bird
intro.parentCue: Point left for bear, right for bird

games.caption: Same words, a little higher
games.parentCue: Lift your hand a little on the second line

games.caption: Little bird, up high
games.parentCue: Chirp together, then tap the right side

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low sounds.

classes.title: Big boots, tiny mouse
classes.goal: Tap the beat with big loud taps, then with tiny soft taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: Noticing big and small: the same tap, more or less

classes.parentPrompt: Make big strong arms for loud taps; whisper and tiptoe your fingers for soft.
classes.childAction: Loud: big farmer boots. Soft: tiny mouse feet.
classes.bridge: Loud taps are the farmer's big boots; soft taps are the mouse tiptoeing.

intro.caption: Big boots, tiny mouse
intro.parentCue: Loud means strong arms, not banging

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing loud and soft.

classes.title: Turtle and bunny farm
classes.goal: Follow the music as it slows like a turtle and speeds like a bunny.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same tune, same shape, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers up your child's back, slowly then quickly, matching the music.
classes.childAction: Turtle music: slow taps. Bunny music: quick taps.
classes.bridge: Slow taps are turtle steps; fast taps are bunny hops round the farm.

intro.caption: Turtle slow, bunny fast
intro.parentCue: Slow down if the taps get wild

games.caption: Bunny in the dell
games.parentCue: Same tune, now quick and light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following slow and fast music.

classes.title: Hi-ho, freeze!
classes.goal: Tap while the music plays and freeze when it stops.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the sound stops, the hands stop too

classes.parentPrompt: Freeze with a funny face when the music stops; cheer when it starts again.
classes.childAction: Tap while music plays. Freeze like a statue when it stops.
classes.bridge: Music on, the circle goes round; music off, everyone stands still.

intro.caption: Go! Tap the beat
intro.parentCue: When the music stops, freeze with a silly face

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for stop and go.

classes.title: The farmer picks you
classes.goal: Make the song together: the grown-up plays the tune, the child keeps the beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together to make one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and watch your child; if they stop, keep playing and smile.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat on any key while your grown-up plays.
classes.bridge: In the circle game, the farmer picks a friend; today, you pick each other.

intro.caption: Play it together
intro.parentCue: Sit side by side, you on the tune

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, two jobs.

classes.title: Farm concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song from the first note to the last, then bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on, and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the tune, then clap, cheer and bow together.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat to the very end, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: Round and round the circle, and the last note brings us home.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: Put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
